E001.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive dashboard that enables administrative staff to monitor real-time patient signals and alerts generated by the system based on the severity of patient symptoms detected during onboarding. This dashboard should facilitate quick identification of cases requiring immediate attention and streamline the intervention process.
E001.Story Description: As an administrative staff member, I want to see real-time alerts for severe patient symptoms so that I can quickly identify cases requiring immediate attention.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Alerts are displayed within seconds of detection.
Alerts highlight severity level with color coding (e.g., red for high severity).
The system provides an audible notification for high-severity alerts.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a real-time alert system backend that processes incoming patient symptom data and identifies severe cases based on predefined severity criteria.
Develop a front-end alert display component on the administrative dashboard that subscribes to the real-time alert system and updates within seconds of new data detection.
Implement color coding on the dashboard alerts, using CSS to assign colors such as red for high severity, yellow for medium, and green for low.
Integrate an audible notification system on the dashboard that triggers a sound alert when a high-severity alert is received. Ensure the system checks for browser permissions to play audio.
Setup a WebSocket or similar real-time communication protocol between the backend and the frontend to ensure alert data is pushed to the dashboard without delay.
Conduct testing to verify that alerts are displayed on the administrative dashboard within seconds of being triggered by the backend system.
Perform an accessibility audit to ensure that color-coded alerts are perceivable by colorblind users, possibly by adding text labels or icons representing severity levels in addition to color coding.
Ensure compliance with web standards and protocols for real-time web communication and investigate the use of existing libraries or frameworks that could expedite development.
Develop a system configuration panel allowing administrative staff to adjust parameters such as the thresholds for severity levels and the types of symptoms that should trigger alerts.
Create comprehensive documentation on the operational use of the real-time alert system on the dashboard, detailing how to manage and respond to alerts effectively.
Implement logging and monitoring of the alert system to track the performance and any issues in real-time alert delivery or display.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component on the dashboard for displaying real-time alerts which, when clicked, expands to show a detailed patient profile view.
Develop backend API to fetch patient details such as contact information, medical history, and recent symptom assessments when an alert is clicked.
Implement a caching mechanism to ensure patient profiles are loaded without noticeable lag, focusing on optimizing the data retrieval process.
Integrate the dashboard alert system with the existing patient monitoring system to ensure real-time data accuracy and responsiveness.
Conduct user testing with administrative staff to validate the usability of the clickable alerts and the clarity of the information displayed in the patient detail view.
Set up error handling and loading states for the UI to manage instances when data fetching might take longer or fail.
Ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations particularly in the handling and display of sensitive patient information in the dashboard.
Implement role-based access control to ensure that only authorized staff can view detailed patient information through the dashboard.
Optimize front-end and back-end performance to handle high traffic and data load, ensuring quick response times as per the acceptance criteria.
Document the technical process and user guide for the new dashboard feature to facilitate training and support for administrative staff.

Tasks.Description: Design a configurable dashboard interface that allows administrative staff to add or remove modular information blocks (widgets) such as patient alerts, medical history, or recent activity.
Implement backend functionality to save the state of the dashboard layout, ensuring that any changes made by the user are stored permanently and retrieved accurately in subsequent sessions.
Develop a user-friendly UI for dashboard customization that includes drag-and-drop capabilities for adding or rearranging information modules, along with clear instructions and tooltips.
Create a preview feature that allows users to see how adjustments to the dashboard layout will appear before finalizing the changes.
Set up a change confirmation system where users must confirm their customization choices through a dialog box or save button, to prevent accidental loss of layout adjustments.
Ensure that the customization options are accessible and perform well on various devices and browsers to accommodate different user preferences and working environments.
Integrate the dashboard layout customization feature with the existing hospital data systems to ensure real-time updates and synchronization of patient information displayed on the dashboard.
Conduct usability testing with a group of administrative staff to gather feedback on the intuitive nature of the customization tools and make iterative improvements based on the feedback received.
Develop comprehensive documentation and tutorial videos explaining how to customize the dashboard, targeting non-technical users to ensure ease of use.
Implement security measures that ensure the customization actions are performed by authenticated users only to prevent unauthorized changes to the dashboard layout.

Historical data includes timestamps of past alerts and interventions.
Data can be filtered by date, symptom severity, and type of intervention.

Tasks.Description: Design a 'Historical Data' section on the dashboard that provides a comprehensive view of each patient's past alerts and interventions.
Implement backend support for storing and retrieving historical patient data, including timestamps, alert types, and intervention details.
Create database queries to fetch historical data based on various filters such as date, symptom severity, and type of intervention.

Develop a frontend interface that allows administrative staff to apply filters to the historical data section. This interface should include dropdowns or input fields for date ranges, symptom severity, and intervention types.
Ensure real-time updates of the historical data view whenever new data is available by implementing WebSocket or long polling techniques.
Incorporate user-friendly visual elements such as charts or timelines to represent the historical data effectively, enhancing the ease of data interpretation.
Implement security measures to ensure that access to historical data is restricted based on staff roles and permissions.
Conduct unit and integration testing to ensure that the historical data section is reliable and performs as expected under various scenarios.

E001.Story Description: As an administrative staff member, I want to quickly escalate urgent cases to the appropriate healthcare professionals so that critical situations are handled promptly and effectively.
Story Acceptance Criteria: An 'escalate' button is available next to each high-severity alert.
Clicking 'escalate' prompts the user to select a doctor or medical team to notify.
The system sends an immediate notification to the selected healthcare professional(s) with patient details and alert information.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the dashboard to include an 'escalate' button next to each high-severity alert. Ensure the button is clearly visible and accessible.
Implement functionality for the 'escalate' button, such that clicking on it opens a modal or popup to select a doctor or medical team from a pre-populated list of available healthcare professionals.

Develop the backend logic to fetch and display a list of healthcare professionals that can be notified in the escalation modal. This list should be dynamically updated based on the hospital staff availability and their specialties.

Create a notification system that triggers an immediate alert to the selected healthcare professional(s) once the administrative staff confirms the escalation. This notification should include critical patient details and alert information.

Ensure the notification system is integrated with the hospital’s existing communication platforms to facilitate immediate transmission of the alert, whether through email, SMS, or internal notification systems.
Implement security measures to ensure that only authorized administrative staff can access the escalation feature, to prevent misuse and protect patient data.

Set up logging and auditing mechanisms to record each use of the escalation feature, including details of who initiated the escalation, at what time, and to whom the alert was sent. This will aid in compliance and accountability.

Conduct testing to verify that the escalation function works as expected under various scenarios, including network failures, multiple simultaneous escalations, and scenarios involving unavailable staff.

Gather feedback from the administrative staff post-deployment to identify any issues or areas for improvement in the escalation process, and plan subsequent updates or patches based on this feedback.

E001.Story Description: As an administrative staff member, I want integrated communication tools on the dashboard so that I can coordinate with healthcare professionals and emergency services directly from the platform.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Communication tools such as email, messaging, and phone call options are accessible directly from the dashboard.
Using these tools does not require leaving the dashboard interface.
Messages and calls can be logged for future reference and audit purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface section on the dashboard specifically for communication tools including email, messaging, and phone call options. Ensure that these tools are conveniently accessible and visible to the administrative staff.
Develop backend services to integrate the dashboard with the existing email server, SMS gateway, and telephony system to enable sending and receiving messages and calls directly from the dashboard.
Implement a method within the dashboard interface that allows users to initiate, receive, and terminate calls without needing to navigate away from the dashboard.

Create functionality within the dashboard that logs all messages and calls made using the communication tools. Ensure logs include timestamp, sender/receiver information, and content of the communication.
Develop a secure storage solution for logs of communications to ensure they can be accessed only by authorized personnel and are protected against unauthorized access.
Test the communication tools integration to ensure they work seamlessly within the dashboard interface, confirming that administrative staff can use these tools without leaving the dashboard.
Prepare documentation detailing the usage of the communication tools on the dashboard, including guidelines for accessing logs and troubleshooting common issues.
Conduct a training session for administrative staff to demonstrate how to use the integrated communication tools effectively and how to access and interpret the communication logs.

E002.Epic Description: Create a secure and efficient system for administrative staff to access and manage patient details such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, and medical histories. This system should support functions like searching, updating, and organizing patient information to aid in communication and care coordination.
E002.Story Description: As an Administrative Staff, I want a secure login mechanism so that unauthorized access to patient information is prevented.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Login page should be accessible from the administrative module.
Support for two-factor authentication.
Login attempts should be logged and monitored for unusual activities.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure login page that is integrated within the administrative module of the system. Ensure that the page is accessible directly from the main dashboard of the administrative module.
Implement two-factor authentication (2FA) for an additional layer of security. This should include integration with an external provider that can send SMS or email verification codes to the user.

Develop a logging mechanism to record all login attempts. This includes successful logins as well as failed attempts. Log details should include timestamp, user identifier, and type of attempt (successful or failed).

Set up a monitoring system capable of alerting administrators to unusual login activities. Define what constitutes 'unusual activities' such as logins from new devices, multiple failed attempts, or logins at odd hours.

Create a user interface for the secure login page that includes input fields for username, password, and second-factor code. Design the interface to be user-friendly while maintaining security standards.

Write unit tests to verify that the login mechanism works as expected under various scenarios including correct credentials, incorrect credentials, and various two-factor authentication states (correct code, incorrect code, expired code).
Implement encryption for password storage and transmission during the login process to ensure data security in compliance with best practices and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and HIPAA.

Integrate the login system with existing administrative tools and databases to ensure seamless access to patient information and other necessary administrative functions immediately upon successful authentication.
Document the entire process, including design decisions, technologies used for 2FA, and guidelines on monitoring login activities, to aid in future maintenance and compliance audits.

Search results should load within 2 seconds.
Relevant patient details (name, contact info, medical summary) are displayed in the search results.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI for the search function in the administrative dashboard, ensuring it includes input fields for names, email addresses, and phone numbers.
Implement the backend search API to handle queries based on names, email addresses, or phone numbers. The API should efficiently search the patient database and return matching records.
Optimize the search query to ensure the results load within 2 seconds. This may involve database indexing or query optimization techniques.
Develop the frontend functionality to display search results in the dashboard. Ensure that the results include relevant patient details such as name, contact information, and a medical summary.
Integrate the search function with the existing patient management system to ensure data consistency and real-time search capabilities.
Implement front-end error handling for the search function to manage scenarios where no records are found or the query fails.
Conduct unit testing on the search functionality to ensure that it meets the acceptance criteria, focusing on response time and data accuracy.
Perform integration testing with the overall patient management system to ensure that the search function works seamlessly with other components.
Document the search functionality in the system user manual, including instructions on how to perform searches and interpret results.
Prepare a presentation or demo to showcase the new search functionality to the administrative staff, highlighting its features and benefits.

Changes must be saved immediately after confirmation.
A log of changes should be maintained for audit purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the patient record update feature. This interface should include editable fields for names, phone numbers, email addresses, and physical addresses.
Implement input validation on the client-side to ensure data integrity for names, phone numbers, email addresses, and addresses within the patient's profile.
Develop server-side logic to handle the submission of updated patient records. Ensure that changes are received and processed by the server.
Create database queries to update patient information in the database. This should handle changes to names, phone numbers, email addresses, and addresses.
Implement immediate persistence of data once changes are confirmed by the user, ensuring data is saved without delay to the database.
Develop a logging mechanism that records all changes made to patient records. Each log entry should include details such as timestamp, user ID, and nature of the change.
Create a review and confirmation step before changes are finalized. This should allow users to verify updated information and confirm changes.
Test the update functionality with various data input scenarios to ensure stability and data integrity. This includes testing for handling of special characters, empty fields, and incorrect formats.
Develop a user manual or help section that guides administrative staff on how to use the update features effectively.
Implement role-based access controls to ensure that only authorized administrative staff can make changes to patient records.

Ensure that the patient sorting and filtering tools are persistently accessible from the main patient management dashboard without requiring navigation to a separate page or module.

Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to assign and modify roles and permissions of other staff members.
Logs should be kept of all access level changes.
Review and approval process for changes in access levels.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for managing access levels that allows administrative staff to assign and modify roles and permissions for different staff members. The interface should include dropdowns or checkboxes for roles and permissions settings.
Develop a backend service to handle the creation, modification, and deletion of user roles and permissions. This service should interact with the database to update user roles and log all changes.

Reports should be exportable in formats such as CSV or PDF.

Implement backend functionality to query the database for patient activities and data updates based on specified time periods.
Develop a report generation module that aggregates and formats the queried data into a readable format.
Create functionality to export generated reports in CSV and PDF formats using appropriate libraries (e.g., pandas for CSV and ReportLab for PDF in Python).
Ensure the report generation process completes within 30 seconds by optimizing queries and using efficient data processing techniques.
Develop a user interface for administrative staff to select report parameters such as time period and data type.
Integrate the reporting module with the existing system's front end, providing access through the administrative dashboard.
Implement security measures to ensure that only authorized staff can generate and view reports, adhering to existing access control mechanisms.

These tools should integrate seamlessly with the existing hospital systems and enhance the overall workflow of hospital operations.
E003.Story Description: As an administrative staff member, I want a tool to schedule appointments efficiently so that I can manage patient appointments without conflicts and with optimal use of hospital resources.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to view all doctor schedules in real-time.
Functionality to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments.
Automatic notifications to patients and doctors when appointments are booked or changed.
Integration with existing hospital calendar systems.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop an API to fetch real-time doctor schedules from the hospital's database. The output should include doctor availability, booked slots, and any time-off or unavailable periods.

Create a user interface (UI) component on the administrative dashboard for displaying the real-time schedules of all doctors. The UI should be intuitive and allow viewing schedules by day, week, or month.
Develop functionality within the administrative dashboard to book appointments. This should include selecting a time slot from a doctor's available schedule and assigning a patient to that slot.
Implement the feature to reschedule appointments, allowing administrative staff to move appointments to new time slots or to a different doctor's schedule, while ensuring there are no conflicts.
Create functionality to cancel appointments, which should involve removing the appointment from the doctor's schedule and optionally sending notifications to affected parties.

Develop a system to automatically send notifications to patients and doctors when an appointment is booked, rescheduled, or cancelled. This should include email and/or SMS notifications based on user preferences.
Integrate the appointment scheduling system with the hospital's existing calendar systems to ensure all changes are reflected across platforms and to avoid data inconsistencies.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the scheduling tool interacts correctly with existing hospital systems and that data flows accurately in real-time without any issues.
Develop security measures for the appointment scheduling tool to ensure that only authorized administrative staff can book, reschedule, or cancel appointments.
Prepare documentation for the appointment scheduling feature, outlining how to use the tool, any limitations, and troubleshooting common issues.
Set up monitoring and logging mechanisms to track the usage of the scheduling tool and capture any errors or security breaches that occur during its operation.

Story Acceptance Criteria: Real-time dashboard showing availability of emergency units and staff.
Quick action buttons to mobilize emergency teams.
Integration with hospital communication systems to alert relevant departments.
Records of all actions taken for audit and review purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design a real-time dashboard interface that displays the current availability of emergency units and staff members. This interface should update automatically without user intervention to reflect any changes in availability.

Implement quick action buttons on the dashboard that allow administrative staff to mobilize emergency teams with a single click. These buttons should be clearly labeled and strategically placed for easy access during critical situations.

Develop backend integration with the hospital's existing communication systems to enable the dashboard to send real-time alerts to relevant departments when an emergency team is mobilized. This integration must ensure that notifications are sent without delay.

Create a logging system that records all actions taken on the emergency services dashboard, including which staff member took the action, what action was taken, and the time the action was executed. This log should be stored securely and be accessible for audit and review purposes.

Conduct usability testing with end-users to ensure that the dashboard is intuitive and meets the operational needs of the administrative staff in managing emergency situations. Collect feedback to iterate on design and functionality enhancements.

Implement security measures to ensure that access to the emergency services dashboard and its functionalities are restricted to authorized administrative staff only. This includes authentication and authorization checks.

Develop comprehensive documentation for the emergency services management dashboard that includes guidelines on how to use the dashboard, troubleshoot common issues, and contact information for technical support.

Read receipts for critical communications.
Integration with mobile devices and hospital workstations.
Options for urgent messaging that require immediate response.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop an API endpoint for sending group notifications to hospital staff. The endpoint should accept parameters such as message content, recipient group, and priority level.
Implement a database schema to store information about each notification sent, including sender, content, timestamp, and read status.
Develop a feature in the notification system to track read receipts for each message sent to hospital staff. This should include storing the time each recipient reads the message.
Create a function to integrate the notification service with mobile devices using push notifications. This function should handle different mobile operating systems like iOS and Android.

Develop a function to integrate the notification system with hospital workstations. This should include pop-up notifications or a dedicated notification panel within the hospital's existing software systems.
Design a user interface for administrative staff to compose and send urgent messages. The interface should include options to mark a message as urgent and require immediate response.
Implement backend logic to prioritize the delivery of urgent messages and ensure they are highlighted in the recipient's notification panel.
Set up a testing framework to simulate the sending and receiving of notifications, including regular and urgent messages, to validate system functionality and reliability.
Create comprehensive documentation on how to use the new communication tools, including steps to send group notifications, urgent messages, and how to view read receipts.

Conduct user acceptance testing with a group of administrative staff to gather feedback on the ease of use and functionality of the communication tools and make necessary adjustments based on the feedback.

Ability to search for patient records by name, ID, or other identifiers.
Integration with the hospital’s main database to fetch real-time patient data.
Functionality to update patient records with appointment and emergency services data.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure login system for the patient information access portal with role-based access control. Ensure that the system can differentiate roles and provide appropriate access levels.

Develop the backend functionality to search for patient records by name, ID, or other identifiers. Include fields in the database to support these search parameters and ensure indexing for efficient retrieval.

Integrate the patient information access portal with the hospital’s main database. This includes establishing a secure and reliable connection to fetch real-time patient data and ensuring data consistency across platforms.

Implement functionality in the patient information access portal to update patient records with data from appointments and emergency services. This should include forms and interfaces for entering and validating new data, as well as backend services to process updates.
Create unit tests for the secure login system to verify that role-based access control is functioning as expected. Tests should cover all roles and edge cases to ensure security compliance.
Develop a user interface for the search functionality that is intuitive and easy-to-use, ensuring compatibility across different devices and screen sizes.

Test the integration between the patient information access portal and the hospital’s main database to confirm data accuracy and real-time synchronization. Include stress tests to evaluate system performance under peak loads.

Story Acceptance Criteria: Automated SMS and email reminders 24 hours before the appointment.
Option for patients to confirm or reschedule via the reminder message.
Tracking of patient responses and automatic update of appointment statuses.
Integration with the patient management system to reflect changes in real-time.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store patient appointment data, including fields for appointment ID, patient ID, appointment time, reminder status, and response status.
Develop a function to calculate the 24-hour reminder time for each appointment and store this in the database.
Implement an SMS and email notification system that triggers reminders at the calculated 24-hour mark before each appointment.
Create an API endpoint to receive patient responses from the reminder messages, allowing patients to confirm or reschedule their appointments.
Develop a function to update the appointment status in the database based on the patient's response from the reminder message.
Integrate the reminder system with the existing patient management system to ensure that any changes in appointment status are updated in real-time across all platforms.
Implement logging for all sent reminders and patient responses to track the efficiency of the reminder system and facilitate audits.
Create a user interface for administrative staff to monitor and manage the status of appointment reminders and responses.
Conduct unit testing for each component of the reminder system to ensure reliability and accuracy in the notification and response handling processes.
Organize a testing phase involving administrative staff to gather feedback on the usability of the system and make necessary adjustments.
Prepare documentation for the system covering setup, operational procedures, and troubleshooting steps for future reference and training.

E004.Story Description: As an Administrative Staff, I want to manage secure access controls so that only authorized personnel can access sensitive health data.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access controls are implemented and tested for different user roles.
Access logs are maintained and regularly reviewed.
Compliance with HIPAA and other relevant regulations is ensured and documented.

Tasks.Description: Define user roles and permissions based on job functions and data access needs within the healthcare system, ensuring compliance with HIPAA regulations.
Develop a role-based access control system module that enforces the defined user roles and permissions when users attempt to access sensitive health data.
