Integrate the data retrieval and analysis functions with the AI chatbot, allowing the chatbot to trigger these functions and receive the necessary data and analyses based on user (doctor) queries.
Ensure that all functions handling patient data follow HIPAA compliance, including encryption of data in transit and at rest, and implement access logs for auditing purposes.
Conduct unit testing on each function to ensure accuracy of data retrieval, analysis accuracy, and visualization clarity. Include tests for edge cases and error handling.
Create a user interface on the doctor's dashboard where the AI chatbot visualizations can be accessed and interacted with, ensuring ease of use and accessibility.
Document the entire development process, focusing on how data is handled, the security measures in place, and user instructions on how to interact with the AI chatbot's new features.

Plan a training session for doctors to familiarize them with the new AI chatbot functionalities, focusing on how to interpret the visual data and how to effectively use the chatbot for patient management.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate an AI chatbot trained on hospital resources to assist doctors with treatment plans or diagnosis suggestions, leveraging data analytics to provide support in making informed medical decisions.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want an interactive and intuitive interface for the AI chatbot so that I can easily navigate through options and efficiently use the chatbot during patient consultations.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Interface is user-friendly and easy to navigate.
Supports voice and text inputs.
Provides clear responses and allows for follow-up questions without losing context.

Tasks.Description: Conduct a user interface (UI) design meeting to define the layout and user journey for the AI chatbot interface based on the requirement for it to be user-friendly and easy to navigate.
Develop wireframes and mockups for the AI chatbot interface, focusing on simplicity and ease of navigation, which must be approved by a focus group of doctors.
Implement voice and text input functionalities in the chatbot interface to allow doctors to interact with the system through both modalities.
Design and implement a response system within the chatbot that provides clear, concise, and context-aware responses to doctor's inquiries.
Integrate a feedback mechanism within the chatbot interface that allows for the testing and enhancement of conversation flow, ensuring users can make follow-up questions without losing the context.
Conduct usability testing sessions with a group of doctors to gather feedback on the interface design and interaction flow of the AI chatbot.
Analyze feedback from usability testing to make necessary adjustments to the UI and interaction design to improve navigation and overall user experience.
Finalize the AI chatbot interface design and ensure all functionalities meet the specified acceptance criteria before deployment.
Develop comprehensive documentation on the usage of the AI chatbot interface to aid doctors in navigating and utilizing the chatbot effectively.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate an AI chatbot trained on hospital resources to assist doctors with treatment plans or diagnosis suggestions, leveraging data analytics to provide support in making informed medical decisions.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want the AI chatbot to suggest emergency protocols when severe symptoms are detected so that I can respond swiftly and appropriately to critical patient conditions.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Chatbot identifies severe symptoms based on predefined thresholds.
Suggests immediate actions and emergency protocols.
Notifies relevant hospital departments automatically if configured to do so.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop an AI model capable of identifying severe symptoms based on predefined thresholds. The model should analyze incoming patient data and flag symptoms that meet or exceed these thresholds.

Create a database or interface for managing and updating the threshold values for severe symptoms, allowing medical staff to adjust the parameters as needed based on new medical guidelines or findings.

Implement a feature in the AI chatbot that allows it to suggest immediate actions and emergency protocols when severe symptoms are identified. These suggestions should be based on the latest medical guidelines and customized to each patient's specific conditions.

Develop a notification system within the AI chatbot framework that can automatically alert relevant hospital departments when severe symptoms are detected and emergency protocols need to be initiated. Ensure the system can be configured to the specific workflow and notification preferences of the hospital.

Integrate the AI chatbot with the hospital's existing healthcare management systems, ensuring that all patient data used by the chatbot is up-to-date and that actions taken by the chatbot are logged and synced across systems.

Conduct a security review of the AI chatbot interactions, particularly focusing on data handling and compliance with healthcare regulations such as HIPAA. This includes ensuring that all data transmissions are encrypted and properly logged.

Plan and execute a series of tests to validate the chatbot's ability to correctly identify severe symptoms, generate appropriate emergency suggestions, and notify relevant departments. These tests should include scenarios with varying degrees of symptom severity to ensure robustness.

Organize training sessions for hospital staff to familiarize them with the new AI chatbot features, focusing on how to respond to emergency protocols suggested by the chatbot and how to modify symptom thresholds if necessary.

Set up a feedback mechanism for users of the AI chatbot to report any issues or suggestions for improvement, particularly regarding the detection of severe symptoms and the triggering of emergency protocols.

Document all features and operational procedures related to the AI chatbot's handling of severe symptom detection and emergency protocol suggestion, ensuring that all documentation is easily accessible to hospital staff.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate an AI chatbot trained on hospital resources to assist doctors with treatment plans or diagnosis suggestions, leveraging data analytics to provide support in making informed medical decisions.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want assurance that the AI chatbot complies with healthcare privacy and security regulations so that patient data is protected and the hospital meets legal standards.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All data interactions comply with HIPAA and other relevant regulations.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access to chatbot and data is logged and monitored for unauthorized access.

Tasks.Description: Review current HIPAA and other relevant healthcare regulations to ensure full understanding and compliance in the development of the AI chatbot.
Design a data encryption strategy for the AI chatbot to ensure that all data in transit and at rest is encrypted using industry-standard encryption protocols.

Implement logging mechanisms within the AI chatbot system to record all access and interactions with the chatbot and its data, ensuring detailed logs include timestamps, user IDs, and types of access.
Develop a secure API for the AI chatbot that ensures all data interactions through the API are compliant with HIPAA and other relevant regulations.
Configure and test the AI chatbot's data storage solutions to ensure encryption at rest, utilizing encryption keys management best practices.
Create a comprehensive access control system for the AI chatbot to ensure that only authorized personnel can access the chatbot and its data, based on predefined roles and permissions.
Conduct a security audit of the AI chatbot to verify compliance with HIPAA and other healthcare regulations, documenting any gaps and creating a plan to address them.
Establish a regular review and update process for the AI chatbot's security measures to ensure ongoing compliance as regulations change and technology evolves.

Develop user guidelines and training materials for doctors and other authorized staff on how to securely interact with the AI chatbot while maintaining compliance with privacy and security regulations.
Implement automatic alerts for unauthorized access attempts or other suspicious activities related to the AI chatbot, and establish a protocol for immediate response to such events.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure authentication system to ensure that patients can securely access their health data and platform functionalities.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to securely log in using multi-factor authentication so that I can ensure my health data is protected from unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The login system must require both a password and a second factor (e.g., SMS code, email verification)
After entering the correct password, the system should automatically prompt for the second authentication factor
The system should lock the account for a brief period after several unsuccessful login attempts
Patients should receive a notification of any unusual login attempts

Tasks.Description: Develop the user login interface that prompts for both a username and a password. Ensure the interface is user-friendly and accessible.
Implement a second factor authentication system that supports SMS codes and email verification. Integrate this system to trigger after successful password entry.
Create backend logic to handle the two-factor authentication process, ensuring it interacts correctly with the front-end inputs and supports secure validation of the second factor.

Incorporate security measures to lock the user account for a brief period after several consecutive unsuccessful login attempts. Define the threshold for unsuccessful attempts and the lockout time period.
Set up a notification system that alerts patients through their registered email or phone number about any unusual login attempts, including details such as time and location of the attempt.
Ensure all login data, including passwords and second-factor authentication codes, are encrypted and securely stored in the database to protect sensitive patient information.
Develop comprehensive logging of all login attempts, successes, and failures to facilitate security monitoring and auditing.
Conduct testing across multiple devices and platforms to ensure the logging system works seamlessly and securely under different scenarios and use cases.
Prepare documentation for the login system covering its functionality, usage, and troubleshooting steps for common issues.
Implement user training for the new login system, including how to set up and use two-factor authentication, and how to recognize and respond to security notifications.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure authentication system to ensure that patients can securely access their health data and platform functionalities.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to easily recover my password through a secure process so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my login details.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients must be able to initiate a password reset from the login page
The system must verify the patient's identity using registered email or phone before allowing a password reset
Patients should receive clear instructions on how to reset their password
Reset links sent via email should be time-limited and expire within a short period

Tasks.Description: Design the UI component for the password reset on the login page, ensuring it includes a clear and accessible option for patients to initiate a password reset.
Develop backend functionality to handle the password reset request which verifies the patient's email or phone number registered in the system databases before proceeding with the reset process.
Create a secure method to send a password reset link via email, ensuring that the link is unique, secure, and time-limited to expire within a short period as defined in the requirements.
Implement clear and concise instructions on both the password reset page and within the email containing the reset link, guiding patients through the process of resetting their password.
Integrate a logging mechanism to record all password reset attempts and completions, including timestamp and user identifier, to monitor and audit usage for security purposes.
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations by encrypting all communication involving personal information and password reset links.

Perform extensive testing of the password reset functionality under various scenarios including successful reset, failed identity verification, and expired link scenarios to ensure robustness and reliability.
Prepare and update documentation for the password reset feature, detailing the process, security measures, and user instructions for future reference and maintenance.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure authentication system to ensure that patients can securely access their health data and platform functionalities.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to log in using biometric authentication options, such as fingerprint or facial recognition, so that I can access my health data more conveniently and securely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must allow patients to set up biometric authentication during the initial account setup or through account settings
Biometric data must be stored securely and not be accessible outside the authentication process
The system should fallback to password authentication if biometric authentication fails
Biometric authentication must be compatible with most modern devices

Tasks.Description: Design a biometric authentication module that integrates with the initial account setup and account settings pages, allowing patients to opt-in for biometric authentication such as fingerprint or facial recognition.
Implement secure storage solutions for biometric data ensuring that the data is encrypted and stored in a secure environment, isolated from other processes and inaccessible to unauthorized users.
Develop functionality for the system to revert to password authentication as a fallback method when biometric authentication fails, ensuring continuous access for the user.
Ensure the biometric authentication feature is compatible with most modern devices, including smartphones and tablets, by integrating with native biometric APIs provided by Android and iOS platforms.
Conduct rigorous testing on various devices to validate the compatibility and reliability of the biometric authentication system, checking for successful integration and fallback scenarios.
Implement logging mechanisms to record biometric authentication attempts, successes, and failures to monitor usage patterns and identify potential security threats.
Create a user-friendly interface within the account settings allowing patients to easily configure biometric authentication options and understand the security implications.

Develop a privacy compliance review process to ensure that the biometric data handling complies with relevant regulations such as GDPR and HIPAA, including proper documentation and data protection impact assessments.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure authentication system to ensure that patients can securely access their health data and platform functionalities.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want the application to automatically log me out after a period of inactivity so that my sensitive health information is protected if I forget to log out.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must automatically log out the user after 15 minutes of inactivity
A warning notification should be displayed 1 minute before automatic logout
Patients must be able to easily log back in to resume their session after being logged out due to inactivity

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a session management mechanism in the backend that tracks user activity and automatically logs out the user after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Implement a client-side feature using JavaScript to check for user inactivity and display a warning notification 1 minute before the automatic logout occurs.
Enhance the login functionality to enable patients to easily log back into their session after being automatically logged out, preserving the state of their last interaction where possible.
Create automated tests to verify that the automatic logout feature works as expected across multiple devices and browsers.
Ensure compliance with privacy and security regulations by encrypting session identifiers and other sensitive information stored on the client side.
Develop user interface components to inform patients of the automatic logout feature during both the login and inactivity warning stages.
Conduct user experience testing to ensure the warning notification and automatic logout process do not disrupt the patient experience adversely.
Prepare documentation for the development team and end-users, explaining the functionality and technical implementation of the automatic logout feature.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure authentication system to ensure that patients can securely access their health data and platform functionalities.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to view a log of all activities performed on my account so that I can monitor any unauthorized access or operations performed under my identity.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must record and display the date, time, and type of activity performed
Patients should be able to access this log from their account settings
The activity log should include successful and unsuccessful login attempts
Patients should be able to report suspicious activities directly from the activity log interface

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store activity logs. This schema should include fields for user ID, date, time, type of activity, and whether the login attempt was successful or not.
Develop a backend service to capture and record all user activities into the database. This includes successful and unsuccessful login attempts, as well as other account-related activities.
Create API endpoints to fetch activity logs from the database. These endpoints should support query parameters to filter logs by user ID and date range.
Integrate the activity logging service with the existing authentication and user account management systems to ensure that every activity is logged as soon as it occurs.

Develop a front-end component in the patient’s account settings to display the activity log. This component should provide a clear and user-friendly interface to view the logs, with columns for date, time, and type of activity.

Implement a feature in the front-end to allow patients to report suspicious activities. This could include a button next to each log entry that opens a form to submit a report, which should then be reviewed by system administrators.
Ensure that all data transmissions involving activity logs are secured with SSL/TLS encryption to protect user data during transit.
Conduct a security review to ensure that access to the activity log API endpoints is properly secured and that only authenticated and authorized users can access their own logs.
Write unit tests for backend services to verify that activity logging, fetching, and reporting features work correctly and handle edge cases such as invalid inputs and unauthorized access attempts.
Plan and execute integration tests to ensure that the new activity logging and reporting features work seamlessly with the existing platform infrastructure and user interfaces.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to authenticate my identity before beginning the onboarding process so that my personal health information remains secure.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Authentication page is accessible upon opening the module.
Support for secure password entry.
System verifies the user's credentials against the hospital's patient database.
Redirects to the onboarding form upon successful authentication.

Tasks.Description: Develop a secure authentication page for the patient onboarding module that loads as the initial interface when the module is accessed.
Implement password input field with security measures such as masking characters and setting minimum complexity requirements.
Integrate backend authentication service to verify user credentials against the hospital's existing patient database securely using HTTPS and encryption.
Upon successful authentication, implement a redirection mechanism that takes the user to the main onboarding form of the patient module.
Set up session management to ensure that the user session is maintained securely during the transition from the authentication page to the onboarding form.
Incorporate error handling for failed authentication attempts that provides users with clear and concise feedback.
Ensure the authentication system logs all login attempts, successful or otherwise, for security auditing and monitoring.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to input details about my symptoms and distress levels so that doctors can assess my current health status accurately.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Input fields for symptoms including pain, tiredness, drowsiness, nausea, appetite, breathing, depression, anxiety, and overall wellbeing.
Each symptom should have a scale from 0 to 10 for severity rating.
Open field for patients to describe any additional symptoms not listed.
Symptoms data is saved and can be reviewed at the end of the session.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the onboarding module where patients can input their symptoms. The interface should include input fields for pain, tiredness, drowsiness, nausea, appetite, breathing, depression, anxiety, and overall wellbeing.
Implement input fields in the user interface, ensuring each symptom can be rated on a scale from 0 to 10. The scale should be clearly marked and easy to use, possibly with sliders or radio buttons.

Add an open text field in the onboarding module where patients can describe any additional symptoms that are not explicitly listed. This field should allow for free text entry with a sufficient character limit to capture detailed descriptions.

Develop backend functionality to capture and store the data from the symptom input fields and the additional symptoms text field. Ensure the data is stored securely in compliance with relevant health data regulations.

Create a review page at the end of the onboarding module where patients can review the symptoms data they have entered. This page should display all entered symptoms and their severity ratings, as well as any additional symptoms described.

Implement functionality that allows patients to edit their symptoms data from the review page before final submission. This should include the ability to go back to the input fields and modify their entries.
Ensure that once the symptoms data is submitted, it is saved to the patient's health record in the system. This data should be immediately accessible for review by healthcare providers.

Conduct thorough testing of the onboarding module to ensure that all fields function correctly, data is stored securely, and edits are captured accurately. Include test cases for both typical and edge-case scenarios.

Prepare user help documentation and tooltips for the onboarding module that guide the patient through the process of entering their symptoms. This should include explanations of each symptom, the severity scale, and how to enter additional symptoms.

Implement accessibility features in the onboarding module to ensure that patients with disabilities can also use the system effectively. This could include keyboard navigability, screen reader support, and high contrast visuals.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Title: Interactive Body Map for Pain Indication
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to use an interactive body map to pinpoint areas of pain so that I can visually communicate my pain points to the healthcare providers.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Interactive front and back human body map is provided.
Patients can click or touch areas to mark pain locations.
Ability to rate pain intensity for each marked area.
Visual indications of selected areas are clearly visible and can be edited before submission.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop the front-end component of an interactive body map representing both front and back views of a human figure.
Implement functionality that allows patients to select and click or touch specific areas on the body map to indicate pain locations.
Create a user interface component that enables patients to rate the intensity of pain for each selected area using a visual scale from 0 to 10.
Ensure that each selected area on the body map has a visual indicator (like color change or pin) which is clearly visible to the user.
Provide the ability for patients to edit their selections and pain intensity ratings on the body map before final submission.
Integrate the front-end of the interactive body map with the backend to store and manage the patient's pain location data securely.
Implement data validation to ensure that inputs received through the interactive body map are within defined parameters (e.g., pain intensity ratings are within the 0-10 range).
Test the interactive body map feature across different devices and browsers to ensure compatibility and responsiveness.
Develop accessibility features for the interactive body map, ensuring it is usable for patients with different abilities.
Prepare documentation for the interactive body map feature that includes instructions for patients on how to use the tool effectively.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to enter my medical history, current medications, and any known allergies so that the medical staff has a comprehensive understanding of my health background.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Separate sections for entering chronic conditions, past surgeries, medications, and allergies.
Ability to add multiple entries under each section.
Option to specify the severity and impact of each condition or allergy.
Information is saved and can be reviewed or edited anytime during the onboarding.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the onboarding module with separate sections for entering chronic conditions, past surgeries, medications, and allergies. Ensure each section is clearly labeled and visually distinct.
Implement input fields within each section of the onboarding module, allowing patients to add multiple entries. Ensure fields are dynamic to accommodate various data lengths and types.

Create dropdown menus or slider options for patients to specify the severity and impact of each chronic condition and allergy. These should provide predefined severity levels to standardize responses.
Develop a backend system to save entered medical history information in the patient's profile. Use secure database storage solutions to ensure data privacy and protection.

Implement functionality to review and edit previously entered medical history at any time during the onboarding process, ensuring data consistency and accuracy with immediate updates reflecting in the system.
Ensure all form inputs and edits are validated both on the client-side and server-side to prevent submission of incorrect or incomplete data forms.
Develop and integrate a secure user authentication process to access the onboarding module, ensuring that sensitive health information is protected from unauthorized access.
Create comprehensive unit and integration tests to validate each function of the onboarding module, particularly focusing on data storage, editing capabilities, and user input validations.

Plan and conduct a user acceptance testing (UAT) session with real users to gather feedback on the usability of the onboarding interface, especially focusing on the ease of entering, reviewing, and editing medical history.
Implement a feature for automatic data saving at regular intervals during the onboarding process to prevent data loss in case of unexpected disruptions.

Design and implement an intuitive navigation system within the onboarding module that guides the patient through filling out their medical history, medications, and allergies sections smoothly and logically.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to provide details about my lifestyle and habits, including tobacco, alcohol, and drug use, so that doctors can consider these factors in my treatment planning.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Fields to enter smoking habits, alcohol consumption, and drug use.
Options to specify quantities and frequency of use.
Include additional questions about recent significant lifestyle changes or stressors.
All data should be confidential and securely stored.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure form layout for inputting lifestyle and habit details, including fields for smoking habits, alcohol consumption, and drug use. Ensure fields allow for multiple entries and adjustable quantities and frequencies.
Implement additional fields in the form for patients to input information about significant lifestyle changes or stressors, with options for textual description.
Develop backend logic to securely handle and store the data entered in the lifestyle and habits form. Ensure encryption of sensitive data both in transit and at rest to maintain confidentiality.
Create validation rules for the input fields to ensure that the data collected is in the correct format and meets the predefined standards for quantities and frequencies.
Integrate the newly created lifestyle and habits form into the existing patient onboarding module, ensuring a seamless user experience and data flow within the system.
Set up secure access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can view the sensitive data submitted in the lifestyle and habits form.
Conduct thorough testing of the form inputs, storage, and retrieval processes to ensure data integrity and security. Include both unit testing and integration testing.
Prepare documentation for the development process and user instructions, highlighting the confidentiality and security measures implemented for handling lifestyle and habits data.
Plan a review session with stakeholders to demonstrate the form functionality and gather feedback for any necessary refinements.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to record any significant medical history in my family so that my healthcare provider can be aware of potential hereditary health risks.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Field to enter various family-related health issues, such as heart disease, diabetes, cancer, etc.
Ability to add details about the relation to the patient and the age of onset.
System stores this data for potential use in diagnostics and treatments.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store family medical history, including fields for health issues (e.g., heart disease, diabetes), relationship to the patient, and age of onset.
Implement a secure user interface form on the patient onboarding module for entering family medical history. Ensure fields for health issues, relations, and age of onset are included.
Develop validation rules for the family medical history input fields to ensure the data entered is in the correct format and all required fields are filled.
Create functionality to dynamically add multiple entries for family medical history in the user interface, allowing patients to add multiple conditions and family members.
Implement backend logic to store the entered family medical history data into the database securely and efficiently.
Ensure the family medical history data is retrievable and can be used in patient diagnostics and treatments by integrating it with the patient's health profile.
Test the family medical history feature end-to-end, including data entry, storage, and retrieval, to ensure it meets all functional and security requirements.
Document the family medical history feature’s functionality and provide guidelines on how to use it effectively within the onboarding module.

E002.Epic Description: Create an onboarding module for patients to input detailed personal health information including symptoms, medical history, and lifestyle habits.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to schedule and receive notifications for follow-up assessments (G8, Sarc-F, QoL) so that I can manage my ongoing health evaluations efficiently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System automatically schedules follow-up assessments based on initial assessment results.
Patients receive notifications about upcoming assessments.
Patients can view scheduled dates and submit new assessment results through the platform.
Assessment scores are logged and can trigger alerts to healthcare providers if scores indicate critical conditions.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store patient assessment schedules, including fields for patient ID, assessment type (G8, Sarc-F, QoL), scheduled dates, and assessment results.
Implement a function to calculate the next assessment dates based on the initial assessment results and predefined intervals for G8, Sarc-F, and QoL assessments.
Develop an API endpoint to automatically update the assessment schedules in the database when initial assessment results are submitted.
Create a notification system that sends reminders to patients via their preferred contact method (email, SMS, app notification) about their upcoming assessment dates.
Build a user interface on the patient platform where patients can view their upcoming and past assessment dates and submit new assessment results.
Develop a backend service to log assessment scores and trigger alerts to healthcare providers if the scores indicate critical conditions.
Ensure that the system securely authenticates the user's identity to maintain privacy and security of the health data during the logging and alert generation processes.
Integrate the new functions with existing patient management systems to ensure data consistency and reliability across platforms.
Conduct comprehensive testing of the scheduling, notification, and alert system to ensure functionality aligns with the user story acceptance criteria.
Prepare documentation for the developed features, detailing the workflow, system interactions, and instructions for future maintenance or upgrades.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a distress screening feature that allows patients to assess and report their symptoms and severity, with built-in notifications for severe symptoms.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to input my symptom severity using a scale from 0 to 10 for various symptoms so that my current health condition can be accurately captured and monitored.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patient can access a digital form on their device.
Form includes scales for pain, tiredness, drowsiness, nausea, appetite, shortness of breath, depression, anxiety, and overall wellbeing.
Each scale ranges from 0 (No symptom) to 10 (Worst possible).
Patient can submit the completed form electronically.
System confirms receipt of the symptom data.

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly digital form interface that patients can access on their devices. The interface should accommodate various device types and screen sizes.
Develop input fields for the digital form to capture symptom severity for pain, tiredness, drowsiness, nausea, appetite, shortness of breath, depression, anxiety, and overall wellbeing.
Implement scales from 0 (No symptom) to 10 (Worst possible) for each symptom in the form. Ensure the scales are interactive and easy to use on mobile devices.
Create a backend service to handle form submissions. This service should securely collect and store the submitted symptom data in the patient's health record.
Develop a submission button for the form that allows patients to electronically submit their completed symptom severity forms.
Implement system functionality to confirm to the user that their symptom data has been received and recorded. This should include visual confirmation on the device screen post-submission.
Ensure compliance with data privacy and security standards during the submission and storage of health data.
Conduct thorough testing on various devices to ensure the digital form is accessible, functional, and user-friendly across different platforms and operating systems.
Prepare user help documentation and on-screen tips for guiding patients on how to fill out and submit the symptom severity form.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a distress screening feature that allows patients to assess and report their symptoms and severity, with built-in notifications for severe symptoms.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want the system to automatically notify healthcare staff if any of my reported symptoms exceed a severity threshold so that immediate medical attention can be provided if necessary.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System analyzes symptom data upon form submission.
If any symptom is rated 7 or higher, an automated alert is generated.
The alert is visible to designated healthcare staff with patient ID and symptom details.
Healthcare staff can acknowledge the alert and initiate follow-up actions.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store patient symptom data, including fields for patient ID, symptom types, severity ratings, and timestamps of data submission.
Develop a RESTful API endpoint to accept symptom data submissions from patient devices or interfaces. This endpoint should validate incoming data and store it in the database.
Create a function that triggers upon submission of symptom data, which parses the incoming data to identify if any symptom severity is rated 7 or higher.

Implement logic within the function to generate an automated alert if any symptom severity meets or exceeds the threshold of 7. This alert should be stored with details including the patient ID, the specific symptoms exceeding the threshold, and the severity level.

Develop a user interface component for the healthcare staff dashboard that displays alerts in real-time. Use WebSocket or long-polling techniques to ensure that the dashboard updates immediately when new alerts are generated.
Integrate an audible or visual notification mechanism on the healthcare staff dashboard to draw attention to new high-severity alerts.
Design and implement a system for healthcare staff to acknowledge received alerts through the dashboard. This should include a mechanism to log who acknowledged the alert and when.

Create a system function that allows healthcare staff to initiate follow-up actions directly from the alert notification on the dashboard. This should include options to contact the patient, escalate the case, or schedule an urgent consultation.
Ensure all patient data handling in the system complies with health data privacy regulations such as HIPAA or GDPR. Implement necessary security measures like data encryption and access controls.
Conduct thorough testing of the new functionalities, including unit tests for the backend processes and integration tests that simulate real-world usage of the symptom reporting and alert system.
Prepare documentation for the new system features, detailing how healthcare staff should use the dashboard features related to alert notifications and follow-up actions.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a distress screening feature that allows patients to assess and report their symptoms and severity, with built-in notifications for severe symptoms.
E003.Story Title: Interactive Body Map for Pain Location
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to use an interactive body map to pinpoint and describe areas of pain so that my doctors can understand the specific locations of my discomfort more accurately.
Story Acceptance Criteria: An interactive image of the human body (front and back) is available in the symptom reporting tool.
Patients can select areas on the image to indicate locations of pain.
Patients can rate the severity of pain at each location using a scale from 0 to 10.
The detailed pain location data can be submitted along with other symptom data.

Tasks.Description: Design the layout for an interactive human body map that includes both front and back views. Ensure the map is detailed enough to allow precise selection of pain areas.

Develop a frontend component for the interactive body map that allows patients to view and interact with the front and back images of the human body. Implement zoom and rotate functionalities for detailed examination.
Implement functionality that enables patients to select specific areas on the body map to indicate pain locations. Ensure that each selected area can be visualized distinctly on the map.

Create a user interface component that allows patients to rate the severity of pain at each selected location on the body map. The rating scale should be from 0 (no pain) to 10 (worst possible pain) and should be easy to adjust.
Integrate the pain severity rating system with the interactive body map, ensuring that each marked area's pain rating is displayed and can be modified by the user.

Develop a backend service to capture and store the pain location data and associated severity ratings from the interactive body map. Ensure data is stored securely and is linked to the patient’s profile.
Implement a submission mechanism that allows patients to send their pain location data along with severity ratings to their healthcare providers. Confirm receipt of the data submission to the user.
Ensure compliance with data privacy laws and regulations in the handling, storage, and transmission of medical data collected through the interactive body map.
Test the interactive body map feature for user accessibility and responsiveness on various devices and screen sizes, ensuring a seamless user experience across platforms.
Conduct user testing sessions with a focus group of patients to gather feedback on the usability of the interactive body map and make necessary adjustments based on feedback.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a distress screening feature that allows patients to assess and report their symptoms and severity, with built-in notifications for severe symptoms.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to receive automated notifications to reassess my symptoms at scheduled intervals (1 month, 6 months, 12 months) so that changes in my condition can be tracked and managed over time.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System schedules future symptom assessments based on the initial assessment date.
Notifications are sent to patients via their preferred contact method (email, app notification) at 1 month, 6 months, and 12 months.
Patients are directed to the symptom assessment form through the notification.
System logs the completion of each scheduled reassessment.

Tasks.Description: Implement a scheduling system that triggers future symptom assessments. The system should automatically calculate and schedule assessments based on the initial assessment date and set reminders for 1 month, 6 months, and 12 months intervals.

Develop a notification system that integrates with the scheduling system to send automated notifications to patients via their preferred contact method (email, application notification) at the scheduled intervals.
Create a user interface component within the patient's application or dashboard that provides a direct link to the symptom assessment form when they receive the notification.
Implement a logging system that records each completion of the scheduled reassessment, capturing data such as the date, time, patient ID, and type of assessment completed.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a distress screening feature that allows patients to assess and report their symptoms and severity, with built-in notifications for severe symptoms.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to be able to review and edit my previously submitted symptom data before my next doctor’s appointment so that my health records are up-to-date and reflect any changes in my condition.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can access their past submitted symptom data through the platform.
Patients can edit their responses and resubmit the updated information.
System updates the patient’s health record with the new data.
System confirms to the patient that the health record has been updated.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface component on the platform that allows patients to view a history of their submitted symptom data. This interface should list each entry with details such as date submitted and symptoms reported.
Implement a feature within the user interface that enables patients to select and view the details of a specific symptom entry from their history.
Develop functionality that allows patients to edit their symptom data in the selected entry. This should include modifying the severity, description, and type of symptoms initially reported.
Create a submission mechanism for the edited symptom data, which should include a 'Submit' button that triggers the update process in the database.

Update the backend to support receiving edited entries and updating the corresponding records in the patient’s health database. Ensure that the updated data replaces the old data accurately without duplication.
Enhance the system's database structure if necessary to allow effective logging of edits, ensuring that each modification is recorded with a timestamp and the patient's ID for audit purposes.
Implement confirmation feedback within the platform that notifies the patient once their health record has been successfully updated. This could be a pop-up message or a banner on the page.
Conduct thorough testing to verify that edited data is correctly reflected in the patient’s health record and that the system properly logs and displays the updated information.
Ensure compliance with relevant privacy and security regulations when handling patient health information during the edit and update processes.
Prepare user help documentation that guides patients on how to access, review, edit, and resubmit their symptom data. Include troubleshooting tips for common issues they might encounter.

E004.Epic Description: Develop an interactive body map tool where patients can visually indicate areas of pain or discomfort, enhancing the accuracy of symptom reporting.
E004.Story Title: User Authentication for Interactive Body Map
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to securely log into the system so that I can access the interactive body map tool to report my pain.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patient can log in using secure credentials.
System verifies identity before granting access to the interactive body map.
Proper error messages are displayed for failed authentication attempts.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure login page for the interactive body map application that requires username and password input.
Implement back-end authentication logic to verify user credentials against the database securely.
Integrate multifactor authentication to ensure an additional layer of security for user login.
Develop front-end logic to handle login attempts and display appropriate error messages for failed authentication attempts.
Set up session management to ensure that once authenticated, the user session is maintained securely across the interactive body map application.
Implement security measures such as HTTPS for secure data transmission during the login process.
Create a system to log all login attempts, recording details such as timestamp, success or failure status, and user identifier.

E004.Epic Description: Develop an interactive body map tool where patients can visually indicate areas of pain or discomfort, enhancing the accuracy of symptom reporting.
E004.Story Title: Access and Navigate Interactive Body Map
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to access and navigate an interactive body map so that I can visually identify and select areas where I feel pain or discomfort.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patient can access the body map after logging in.
The body map displays front and back views of the human body.
Patients can zoom in/out and rotate the view for detailed selection.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure user authentication system that verifies patient credentials before providing access to the interactive body map feature.
Develop the interactive body map interface, ensuring it includes both front and back views of the human body.
Implement functionality allowing patients to zoom in and out on the body map for detailed viewing of specific body areas.
Add the ability for patients to rotate the body map, enabling viewing from different angles to ensure comprehensive visual access to all body parts.
Ensure the body map is integrated into the patient's dashboard accessible immediately after login, with immediate loading of the feature on user request.
Conduct usability testing with patients to validate ease of navigation, zoom, and rotation functions on the body map, adjusting based on feedback to ensure intuitive user experience.
Develop and integrate backend services that support the real-time display and manipulation of the body map, ensuring smooth and responsive user interactions.
Implement access logs for usage of the body map tool to monitor patient engagement and identify potential improvements based on usage patterns.

E004.Epic Description: Develop an interactive body map tool where patients can visually indicate areas of pain or discomfort, enhancing the accuracy of symptom reporting.
E004.Story Title: Mark Pain Points on Body Map
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to mark areas on the interactive body map where I feel pain so that I can accurately communicate the locations of my symptoms to healthcare providers.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can select multiple areas on the body map.
Each selection allows entering details such as intensity of pain on a scale of 0-10.
Patients can modify or remove a pain point before final submission.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the interactive body map that includes both front and back views of a human body. Ensure the interface is responsive and accessible across different devices such as tablets and desktops.
Implement functionality to allow patients to select multiple areas on the body map. Use interactive hotspots on the body map that users can click or tap to select.

Develop an input method for patients to enter details about the intensity of pain for each selected area. Provide a scale from 0 to 10 next to each selected area where patients can input or adjust the pain level.
Create a feature for patients to modify or remove a previously marked pain point. This should include options to adjust the location, change the intensity level, or completely remove the selection.

Ensure that all patient interactions with the body map are captured and can be saved temporarily as the patient moves through the selection process. This session data should be held until final submission to accommodate modifications.

Implement a final submission process for the completed body map, including a confirmation step where patients review their inputs before finalizing. This should include a summary view of all selected areas and their corresponding pain levels.
Establish secure data handling protocols to ensure that all patient data collected through the body map tool is encrypted and stored securely in compliance with health data regulations.
Integrate the body map tool with the existing patient records system to ensure that the pain location and intensity data is directly stored in the patient’s health record upon submission.

Conduct usability testing with a focus group of patients to gather feedback on the ease of use, interface design, and overall experience of marking pain points on the interactive body map. Use this feedback to make iterative improvements.

Develop comprehensive documentation that includes instructions on how to use the interactive body map tool, troubleshooting common issues, and explaining the importance of accurately reporting pain locations and levels.

E004.Epic Description: Develop an interactive body map tool where patients can visually indicate areas of pain or discomfort, enhancing the accuracy of symptom reporting.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to submit the pain information I marked on the body map so that my healthcare providers can review and use this information for my diagnosis and treatment.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Submit button is clearly visible after marking pain on the body map.
Confirmation message appears after successful submission.
Submitted data is saved in the patient's medical record securely.

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly interface for the pain information submission section on the interactive body map tool, ensuring the submit button is prominently displayed and easy to locate.
Implement frontend functionality using JavaScript to capture and package all marked pain information from the interactive body map when the submit button is clicked.
Develop backend API to receive pain information data from the frontend, ensuring secure handling and processing of the data in compliance with privacy standards.
Create a database model to store patient's pain information securely. Include fields for patient ID, date, and detailed pain locations with severity ratings.
Integrate the submission API with the existing patient medical records system to ensure that submitted pain information is correctly associated with the patient's profile.
Implement a confirmation mechanism that triggers a message to the user's interface confirming successful submission of pain information.
Conduct thorough testing of the pain information submission process, focusing on usability, data integrity, and security.
Prepare user documentation that explains how to use the interactive body map tool to mark and submit pain information, including screenshots and troubleshooting tips.
Review and ensure compliance with healthcare data protection regulations for the handling and storage of patient information within the system.

E004.Epic Description: Develop an interactive body map tool where patients can visually indicate areas of pain or discomfort, enhancing the accuracy of symptom reporting.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to review and edit previously marked pain points on my body map so that I can update any changes in my condition before my next consultation.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can view their previously submitted pain points.
Patients can edit the intensity and location of each pain point.
Changes can be saved and confirmed with an update confirmation message.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for viewing previously submitted pain points on the interactive body map. Ensure the interface allows patients to visually identify and select past entries.
Implement functionality to fetch and display existing pain point data from the database when a patient accesses their historical body map view.

Develop editing capabilities that allow patients to adjust the intensity and location of each pain point directly on the interactive body map. Include sliders or input fields for adjusting pain intensity.
Create a save mechanism that updates the patient's edited pain points in the database. This should overwrite the previous entries with the new data while maintaining an audit trail of changes.
Implement a confirmation message that appears after a patient successfully saves their changes. This message should verify that the updates have been recorded in the system.
Ensure that the interactive body map tool is responsive and functions correctly across different devices and platforms, such as tablets and web browsers, to accommodate various user access scenarios.
Conduct usability testing with a focus group of patients to gather feedback on the ease of use and functionality of the editing features in the interactive body map tool.
Review and implement necessary security measures to protect patient data during the fetching, editing, and saving processes. Ensure compliance with health data protection standards.
Document the new features and provide help resources or tooltips in the application to assist patients in understanding how to access and use the editing features on their body map.

E004.Epic Description: Develop an interactive body map tool where patients can visually indicate areas of pain or discomfort, enhancing the accuracy of symptom reporting.
E004.Story Title: Help and Support for Interactive Body Map Tool
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to access help and support features while using the interactive body map so that I can understand how to properly use the tool and ensure my symptom data is accurately captured.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Help button is accessible on every screen of the body map tool.
Support includes step-by-step instructions and FAQs about using the body map.
Contact information for technical support is provided.

Tasks.Description: Design a persistent UI component for a 'Help' button that is visible on every screen of the interactive body map tool. This button should be consistently placed in a familiar, easy-to-access location across different screens to ensure user familiarity and ease of use.

Create content for a comprehensive support page, including step-by-step instructions on how to use the interactive body map tool. This content should cover common functionalities such as how to select, mark, and describe pain points, as well as how to navigate between different views of the body map.

Develop a FAQ section specifically for the interactive body map tool. Include answers to common questions such as how to modify or delete marked pain points, what each symbol or color means on the map, and troubleshooting steps for common issues like unresponsive interface elements.

Implement a feature within the help section where users can easily access contact information for technical support. This should include multiple methods of contact such as email, phone, and possibly a live chat option, ensuring that users can reach out for help in their preferred manner.

Integrate the help button within the interactive body map tool such that clicking on it does not disrupt the user's current activity on the map. Ensure that opening the help section occurs in a non-intrusive overlay or a side panel which can be easily closed, preserving the user's progress on the map.

Conduct user testing to validate the effectiveness of the help and support features. Focus on assessing the clarity of the provided instructions, the ease of accessing the help section, and the overall user satisfaction with the support available while using the interactive body map tool.

Ensure compliance with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) for all help and support features to accommodate users with disabilities. This includes providing text alternatives for non-text content, ensuring keyboard navigability, and supporting screen readers.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate health assessment tools such as G8 Questionnaire, Sarc-F, and QoL assessments, with reminders and notifications for follow-up.
E005.Story Title: User Story 1: Patient Authentication for Health Assessment
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to securely authenticate before accessing the assessment tools, so that my health information is protected.
Story Acceptance Criteria: User can authenticate using a secure login mechanism.
Authentication must occur before access to any health assessment features.
System logs and monitors login attempts for security purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design a user authentication interface that requests username and password input from the patient to initiate the login process.
Implement backend logic to validate the entered credentials against the hospital's secure patient database.
Develop a secure login mechanism that includes hashing passwords and using secure communication protocols (e.g., HTTPS) to protect data during transmission.
Integrate multi-factor authentication as an additional security layer, providing options such as SMS codes or email verification.
Set up a system to log all login attempts, including successful logins and failed attempts, noting the timestamp, user ID, and IP address.
Create rules within the system to lock the user account temporarily after multiple consecutive unsuccessful login attempts to prevent brute force attacks.
Implement session management to ensure that the user is automatically logged out after a certain period of inactivity for increased security.
Build a backend mechanism to monitor unusual login activities (e.g., multiple failed login attempts, unexpected IP addresses) and alert system administrators.
Ensure that the login process is compliant with relevant data protection and privacy regulations, such as HIPAA, by conducting regular security audits and updates.
Develop a user-friendly error handling system that provides clear and instructive feedback for login issues, such as incorrect passwords or system errors.
Configure the system to enforce password complexity requirements and prompt users for regular password updates to enhance account security.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate health assessment tools such as G8 Questionnaire, Sarc-F, and QoL assessments, with reminders and notifications for follow-up.
E005.Story Title: User Story 2: Completion of G8 Questionnaire
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to easily complete the G8 Questionnaire at predefined intervals, so that my health condition can be monitored over time.
Story Acceptance Criteria: G8 Questionnaire is accessible via the user dashboard.
The questionnaire can be completed electronically and submitted to the system.
System notifies the patient when it's time to fill the questionnaire based on predefined intervals.
System records the scores and alerts the nursing staff if the score is below 14.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the G8 Questionnaire accessible via the patient dashboard. Include clear navigation and user-friendly design.
Develop the backend functionality to load and display the G8 Questionnaire form electronically on the user dashboard.
Implement form validation to ensure all required fields in the G8 Questionnaire are filled before submission is allowed.
Create a database schema to store responses from the G8 Questionnaire, including timestamps and patient IDs.
Develop a function to submit the completed G8 Questionnaire to the backend and save the responses in the database.
Implement a scheduling system in the backend that triggers notifications for patients to fill out the G8 Questionnaire at predefined intervals.
Create a notification system that alerts patients via their preferred method (email, SMS, app notification) when it is time to complete the G8 Questionnaire.
Develop a scoring algorithm for the G8 Questionnaire to assess and record the total score upon submission.
Implement a function that checks if the total score from the G8 Questionnaire is below 14 and triggers an alert to the nursing staff.
Ensure system security and patient confidentiality by implementing data encryption for stored and transmitted G8 Questionnaire data.
Perform comprehensive testing of the G8 Questionnaire feature including functionality, usability, and security testing.
Prepare documentation for the G8 Questionnaire feature detailing usage, troubleshooting, and technical specifications.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate health assessment tools such as G8 Questionnaire, Sarc-F, and QoL assessments, with reminders and notifications for follow-up.
E005.Story Title: User Story 3: Completion of Sarc-F Assessment
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to complete the Sarc-F Assessment as required, so that any sarcopenia conditions can be detected and addressed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Sarc-F Assessment is integrated and available on the platform.
Patients can fill out the assessment at their convenience without waiting for a doctor's appointment.
Scores are automatically calculated and a notification is sent to the medical team if the score is below 14.

Tasks.Description: Develop a user interface for the Sarc-F Assessment, ensuring it is integrated within the existing patient platform. The interface should include input fields for each of the Sarc-F Assessment questions, which typically cover strength, assistance in walking, rise from a chair, climb stairs, and falls.

Implement a backend function in Python to handle the input from the Sarc-F Assessment form. The function should collect responses from patients, calculate the total score, and store the results in the patient's health records.

Create a database model to save Sarc-F Assessment scores with fields for patient ID, date of assessment, individual question scores, total score, and any comments from the patient. Ensure the model supports CRUD operations and is linked to the patient's profile.

Implement a notification system that triggers an alert to the medical team if the Sarc-F Assessment score is below 14. The alert should include the patient's ID, score details, and a direct link to the patient's assessment results.

Ensure the Sarc-F Assessment form and results are accessible to patients at any time from their dashboard. Include functionality for patients to fill out the assessment multiple times and track their scores over time.
Conduct unit testing on the Sarc-F Assessment feature to ensure that the scoring algorithm works correctly and that score submissions update the database accurately without any data loss.
Perform integration testing to verify that the Sarc-F Assessment interacts correctly with other systems, such as health record storage and notification dispatch systems.
Set up role-based access control to ensure that only authorized medical staff can view the Sarc-F scores and receive notifications, preserving patient confidentiality.
Develop user documentation that explains how to navigate to and complete the Sarc-F Assessment through the patient portal. Include troubleshooting tips and contact information for technical support.
Organize a training session for medical staff to familiarize them with the new Sarc-F Assessment tool, focusing on how to access and interpret patient scores and respond to alerts.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate health assessment tools such as G8 Questionnaire, Sarc-F, and QoL assessments, with reminders and notifications for follow-up.
E005.Story Title: User Story 4: Scheduled Notifications for QoL Assessment
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to receive notifications for the QoL Assessment follow-ups, so that I can regularly check and report my quality of life status.
Story Acceptance Criteria: QoL assessment notifications are scheduled for 1 month, 6 months, and 12 months post-initial assessment.
Patients receive these notifications through the app with direct links to start the assessment.
Completed assessments are stored in the patient's profile for future reference.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store QoL assessment schedules and completed assessments for each patient. Include fields for patient ID, schedule dates, completion status, and links to assessment forms.
Develop a scheduling system backend that automatically calculates and stores upcoming QoL assessment dates (1 month, 6 months, 12 months) based on the date of the initial assessment.

Implement a notification system that triggers reminders for patients on scheduled QoL assessment dates. Ensure that notifications can be sent via the app and include direct links to the QoL assessment form.
Create an API endpoint that allows the retrieval and updating of scheduled and completed QoL assessment data linked to a patient's profile.
Develop a user interface in the patient's app dashboard where they can view upcoming and completed QoL assessments. This interface should also provide direct access to start or resume an assessment.
Ensure that completed QoL assessments are stored in the patient's profile with a timestamp and can be accessed for future reference. Implement necessary security measures to safeguard this data.
Integrate the QoL assessment tool with the existing patient management system, ensuring real-time synchronization of assessment data.
Set up a system to log every access and update to the QoL assessment data, ensuring traceability and compliance with healthcare data protection regulations.

Conduct thorough testing of the scheduling, notification, and data storage functionalities to ensure they work as expected and handle edge cases like leap years, time zone differences, and daylight saving changes.
Prepare user documentation and help materials to assist patients in understanding how to access and complete their QoL assessments through the app.

E005.Epic Description: Integrate health assessment tools such as G8 Questionnaire, Sarc-F, and QoL assessments, with reminders and notifications for follow-up.
