E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to view and track my completed assessments history, so that I can be informed about my health progress over time.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can access a history log of all completed assessments from their user dashboard.
Each entry in the history log includes dates, scores, and any notes from healthcare providers.
History log is updated in real-time post each assessment completion.

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly interface for the patient's dashboard that includes a section for accessing the history log of completed assessments.
Develop a backend API to fetch the history log of completed assessments for a patient. The API should retrieve dates, scores, and notes from healthcare providers associated with each assessment.
Implement database schema modifications to support storing and querying assessment histories, including dates, scores, and healthcare provider notes.
Create a real-time update mechanism on the server-side to ensure that the assessment history log is immediately updated whenever new assessment data is entered into the system.
Integrate the assessment history log display in the patient dashboard with the backend API, ensuring data is fetched and displayed in real-time.
Conduct user acceptance testing to verify that patients can access and view their assessment history log correctly, and that entries include all required details such as dates, scores, and notes.
Set up a secure authentication and authorization process to ensure that patients can only access their own assessment histories.
Optimize the performance of the dashboard and assessment history log feature to handle multiple concurrent users without significant lag or data integrity issues.
Develop comprehensive unit tests for the new backend APIs and database operations related to the assessment history log.
Document the feature's functionality and provide guidelines in the help section of the patient dashboard on how to access and understand the assessment history log.

E006.Epic Description: Create an AI Chat Bot that provides patients with access to their Q&A history, allows them to search health-related information, and offers guidance based on their health data.
E006.Story Description: As a patient, I want to access my previous Q&A history with the AI Chat Bot so that I can review past interactions and information provided.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Users can log in and view a list of past Q&A sessions.
Each entry in the Q&A history should display the date and the summary of the conversation.
The user interface should be intuitive, allowing easy navigation through history entries.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure login system for the AI Chat Bot interface to authenticate users before they can access their Q&A history.
Develop a backend service to retrieve the Q&A history from the database, which includes fetching the date and summary of each conversation based on user credentials.
Create a frontend interface that displays the Q&A history as a list, with each entry showing the date and a summary of the conversation.
Ensure the user interface for viewing Q&A history is intuitive, supporting easy navigation and interaction for the users.
Implement functionality that allows users to click on an entry in the Q&A history to expand and view more detailed information about that session.
Test the Q&A history viewing feature to ensure it meets all acceptance criteria: login functionality, accurate data display, and intuitive navigation.
Prepare documentation for the Q&A history feature that includes usage instructions for the end-users and maintenance guidelines for future support teams.

E006.Epic Description: Create an AI Chat Bot that provides patients with access to their Q&A history, allows them to search health-related information, and offers guidance based on their health data.
E006.Story Description: As a patient, I want to search for health-related information using keywords so that I can quickly find relevant information without having to re-ask questions.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The chat bot should accept input in the form of text queries.
The search function should utilize keywords to fetch relevant Q&A pairs or new information.
Search results should be presented in a clear, easy-to-read format.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a text input interface for the AI Chat Bot that accepts keyword searches from users. This interface should be accessible from the main dashboard where patients interact with the chat bot.

Develop a keyword parsing algorithm that extracts and interprets keywords from user queries. This algorithm should handle variations in keyword phrasing and synonyms to improve the search flexibility and accuracy.

Create a search function that queries a database containing Q&A pairs and health-related information. This function should utilize the keywords extracted by the parsing algorithm to fetch relevant data efficiently.

Implement a response system for the AI Chat Bot that formats the search results into a clear, easy-to-read format. Ensure that the information is presented in a structured layout that enhances user readability and comprehension.

Integrate the AI Chat Bot's search functionality with existing patient data systems to pull personalized suggestions or information based on the patient's health history when relevant keywords are searched.

Conduct thorough testing of the keyword search functionality to verify that the chat bot accurately interprets and responds to user queries with relevant information. Include a variety of test cases to cover different user intents and keyword complexities.
Prepare documentation for the keyword search feature detailing how to use it, the scope of information it can retrieve, and troubleshooting steps for common issues encountered by users.

Set up a feedback mechanism where users can rate the usefulness of the information provided by the search function. Use this feedback to refine and improve the parsing algorithms and response accuracy.

E006.Epic Description: Create an AI Chat Bot that provides patients with access to their Q&A history, allows them to search health-related information, and offers guidance based on their health data.
E006.Story Description: As a patient, I want to receive guidance based on my health data so that I can understand potential health actions or precautions I should consider.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The AI Chat Bot needs to analyze the user's health data and provide customized advice.
The system must ensure data privacy and comply with relevant health data regulations.
Users should receive suggestions or guidance in a conversational manner to enhance understanding and engagement.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop a data analysis module for the AI Chat Bot that can process and interpret patient health data. This module will leverage algorithms to assess patient data and generate health recommendations.

Implement data privacy measures for the AI Chat Bot, ensuring all patient data is handled and stored in compliance with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations. This includes encrypting data in transit and at rest, and setting up access controls.

Develop a conversational user interface for the AI Chat Bot that can interact with patients in a clear, engaging manner. The interface should support text input and provide responses in a conversational style to enhance user engagement.

Create a system for the AI Chat Bot to deliver personalized health advice based on the analysis of patient data. Ensure the advice is presented in an understandable format, contextualized with the patient’s health records.
Test the AI Chat Bot’s ability to analyze and interpret patient health data accurately and reliably, ensuring the guidance provided is based on the most current and relevant health data.

Validate that the AI Chat Bot complies with all necessary data protection and privacy regulations during a security audit. This includes reviewing the encryption standards used and verifying compliance with health data protection regulations.
Integrate the AI Chat Bot with existing hospital systems to pull real-time health data for each patient. Ensure seamless data synchronization to maintain data accuracy and completeness.
Develop documentation and help resources for patients using the AI Chat Bot, explaining how to interact with the bot and how it uses their health data to provide recommendations.
Conduct user acceptance testing with a focus group of patients to gather feedback on the usability of the AI Chat Bot and the relevance and helpfulness of the health advice provided.
Implement logging and monitoring of interactions with the AI Chat Bot to ensure all activities are tracked and can be audited to enhance security and compliance.

E006.Epic Description: Create an AI Chat Bot that provides patients with access to their Q&A history, allows them to search health-related information, and offers guidance based on their health data.
E006.Story Description: As a patient, I want to select specific questions or answers from my history and get more detailed information on them so that I can better understand the topics discussed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Users should be able to click on any question or answer in their history to expand details.
The detailed view should provide additional context or links to further reading.
This feature should be accessible from both mobile and desktop platforms to ensure accessibility.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface component for displaying Q&A history, allowing users to view a list of their past questions and answers.
Implement functionality for users to click on any item in their Q&A history to expand it and view more details.
Develop a backend service to retrieve detailed information for a selected Q&A item including additional context or related links.
Integrate external sources or databases as needed to provide additional reading links or context related to the user's questions or answers.
Ensure the Q&A detail expansion feature is responsive and functions seamlessly across different device types, including mobiles and desktops.
Perform cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure the expanded Q&A details are displayed correctly and are accessible on all supported devices.
Deploy the updated AI Chat Bot feature to a staging environment for integration testing with the existing systems to ensure compatibility and functionality.
Collect feedback from a select group of users on the usability and functionality of the new feature in the AI Chat Bot, making adjustments based on the feedback.
Prepare and deliver documentation on how to use the new Q&A history detail expansion feature for inclusion in the user help section of the application.

E006.Epic Description: Create an AI Chat Bot that provides patients with access to their Q&A history, allows them to search health-related information, and offers guidance based on their health data.
E006.Story Title: Continuous Learning for AI Chat Bot
E006.Story Description: As a patient, I want the AI Chat Bot to learn from our interactions and improve its responses over time so that the information becomes more relevant and tailored to my needs.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system should implement machine learning techniques to evolve the chat bot's knowledge base.
Users can provide feedback on the accuracy and helpfulness of the responses received.
The system should log and analyze feedback to guide the learning process.

Tasks.Description: Implement machine learning model to analyze and learn from user interactions within the AI Chat Bot. Choose an appropriate NLP model that can be trained with existing Q&A pairs and adapt over time based on new interactions.

Create a feedback mechanism in the AI Chat Bot interface where users can rate the helpfulness and accuracy of the responses received. Include options for textual feedback to gather more detailed user impressions.

Develop a logging system that captures all user interactions with the AI Chat Bot, including questions asked, responses given, feedback received, and timestamps. Ensure that this data is stored securely and is accessible only to authorized personnel.

Integrate the feedback received from users into the training dataset for the machine learning model. Establish a routine process for periodically retraining the model with new data to ensure continuous learning and improvement.

Set up automated analytics on the logged data to identify common patterns, frequently asked questions, and areas where the Chat Bot's responses are frequently marked as unhelpful. Use these insights to prioritize updates to the Chat Bot's knowledge base.

Implement a monitoring dashboard for system administrators to view the performance of the AI Chat Bot, including metrics on user engagement, feedback scores, and learning model accuracy. This will aid in ongoing system evaluation and adjustment.

Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations by encrypting sensitive user data, both in transit and at rest. Regularly review and update data handling and storage protocols to maintain high security standards.

E007.Epic Description: Develop a system to generate a digital summary page of the patient's health information, which can be reviewed or shared digitally whenever needed.
E007.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to authenticate securely so that I can access my health data safely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System prompts for username and password.
Authentication must be secure and encrypted.
System provides error feedback on failed login attempts.
Successful login takes the user to their personal dashboard.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure login form that prompts for username and password. Ensure the form is accessible and user-friendly with clear fields for input.
Implement backend authentication logic using secure, up-to-date encryption methods for password storage and verification, such as bcrypt or Argon2.
Develop front-end and back-end validation for the login form to check for common user input errors and provide meaningful error messages to the user.
Configure the authentication system to provide feedback on failed login attempts, including incorrect username or password and account lockout notifications after multiple failed attempts.
Set up a secure session management system that directs users to their personal dashboard upon successful login, ensuring that sessions are uniquely identified and managed securely.
Incorporate HTTPS for all data transactions between the client and server to ensure data privacy and security in transit.
Implement rate limiting and monitoring of login attempts to prevent brute force attacks and alert admins of any unusual activities.
Design and implement an audit trail for all login activities, logging details such as timestamp, IP address, and login outcome, to enhance security monitoring.
Ensure compliance with relevant data protection regulations such as GDPR or HIPAA in all authentication processes, including data handling and storage.
Create unit tests for authentication functions to verify that security measures are effective and that the system behaves as expected under various scenarios.
Document the authentication feature implementation details, including security practices and session management strategies, for future maintenance and audits.
Implement a user interface (UI) design enhancement for the login page, focusing on accessibility and user experience, ensuring it is responsive across devices.

E007.Epic Description: Develop a system to generate a digital summary page of the patient's health information, which can be reviewed or shared digitally whenever needed.
E007.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to complete a detailed onboarding module so that my health information is updated in my digital profile.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System provides a step-by-step questionnaire.
Input fields for detailed health information are present (symptoms, medical history, etc.).
Patients can submit or revise their answers.
System confirms information is saved and updates the patient profile.

Tasks.Description: Design a step-by-step questionnaire interface for the onboarding module. The interface should guide patients through a series of questions about their health information, such as symptoms and medical history.

Develop input fields for the questionnaire. These fields must cover detailed health information categories like symptoms, medical history, allergies, current medications, and lifestyle choices. Ensure all fields are validated for correct data type entries (e.g., text, numeric).
Implement functionality for patients to submit their responses. This includes a submission button that gathers all input data and sends it to the server for processing.
Create backend logic to receive and process submitted health information. Ensure that data is properly stored in the patient’s digital profile in the database.

Add functionality for patients to review and revise their answers before final submission. This should include an edit option for each section of the questionnaire that re-displays the input fields with previously entered data.

Implement a confirmation mechanism post-submission. Once the data is saved, the system should display a confirmation message to the patient indicating that their health information has been updated successfully.
Conduct unit testing for the questionnaire form to ensure that all input fields capture data correctly, submissions are handled properly, and patient profiles are updated without data loss.

Perform integration testing with the overall patient digital profile management system to ensure that new data from the onboarding module is accurately reflected in the patient's overall digital health record.

Ensure compliance with data privacy and security standards when handling patient health information. This includes encrypting data in transit and at rest, and implementing access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can view or modify sensitive information.
Develop a user guide or help section that explains how to fill out the questionnaire, including details about what each field represents and why the information is necessary.

E007.Epic Description: Develop a system to generate a digital summary page of the patient's health information, which can be reviewed or shared digitally whenever needed.
E007.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to indicate areas of pain using an interactive body map so that my physician can understand my physical symptoms accurately.
Story Acceptance Criteria: A detailed interactive image of the human body is accessible.
Patients can click or touch areas to describe pain.
Pain levels can be rated on a scale.
Information from the body map updates the patient’s health record.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop a detailed interactive image of the human body, ensuring it can be accessed on multiple device types including desktops, tablets, and mobile.
Implement functionality for the interactive body map that allows patients to click or touch areas to indicate pain points.
Create an input mechanism for patients to rate pain levels on a scale, possibly using a slider or numerical input adjacent to the selected area on the body map.
Develop the backend logic to capture and store the pain level data and the specific areas of pain that patients identify on the interactive body map.
Ensure the interactive body map interface updates the patient's health record in real-time, with appropriate data validation and error handling to maintain data integrity.
Set up secure data transmission protocols to ensure that all interactions with the body map and subsequent data storage comply with healthcare data protection regulations.
Conduct thorough testing across different devices to ensure the interactive body map is responsive and functions correctly on all intended platforms.
Prepare documentation for the interactive body map tool that includes technical specifications, user instructions, and troubleshooting guidelines.
Plan and execute a user acceptance testing phase with a group of patients to gather feedback on the usability and functionality of the interactive body map.
Create an update and maintenance plan for the interactive body map tool to handle potential issues, upgrades, and integration with other systems in the future.

E007.Epic Description: Develop a system to generate a digital summary page of the patient's health information, which can be reviewed or shared digitally whenever needed.
E007.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to view my digital health summary so that I can review my medical information conveniently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The summary page is accessible through the patient dashboard.
Health data is clearly presented and updated in real-time.
Patients can refresh the summary to see the latest information.
Health summary includes data from the latest assessments and onboarding.

Tasks.Description: Develop the backend functionality to fetch the latest health data from the database. Ensure the data includes patient assessments and onboarding information.
Create an API endpoint that allows real-time fetching of patient health data when requested from the front end.
Design and implement the user interface for the digital health summary page on the patient dashboard. Include sections for recent assessments and onboarding information.
Implement real-time data presentation on the digital health summary page, ensuring data is updated immediately as it changes in the database.
Add a 'Refresh' button on the digital health summary page that, when clicked, triggers a fetch request to the API to load the most current health data.
Integrate the digital health summary page with existing patient dashboard navigation, ensuring seamless access for patients through a clearly labeled menu or link.
Conduct unit testing on the backend to verify that the health data fetch functionality works correctly and efficiently.
Conduct integration testing to ensure that the API endpoint correctly interacts with the front end, delivering data in real-time.
Perform user acceptance testing with a group of patients to ensure the digital health summary page meets the outlined acceptance criteria and is user-friendly.
Ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations in the handling and presentation of health data on the digital health summary page.
Prepare documentation for the digital health summary feature, covering both technical implementation details and user guidelines.

E007.Epic Description: Develop a system to generate a digital summary page of the patient's health information, which can be reviewed or shared digitally whenever needed.
E007.Story Title: QR Code Generation for History Transfer
E007.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to generate a QR code that contains my medical history so that I can share it quickly with any physician.
Story Acceptance Criteria: QR code generation is a feature in the patient dashboard.
QR code securely encapsulates the patient’s medical history.
Instructions for use are clearly provided.
QR code can be saved, printed, or shared directly via the platform.

Tasks.Description: Design a QR code generation feature that will be integrated into the patient dashboard. Ensure that the design aligns with the overall interface and user experience of the dashboard.
Develop backend functionality to securely fetch and encrypt the patient's comprehensive medical history data. Use secure encryption methods to encapsulate this data into a QR code.
Implement a user interface on the patient dashboard for generating the QR code. Include buttons or controls that allow users to generate, view, and refresh the QR code.
Create detailed instructions on the dashboard on how to use the QR code feature. This should include steps on how to generate, save, print, and share the QR code.
Enable functionality to save the generated QR code as an image file within the patient’s device or system. Ensure the saved file is secure and accessible only to the patient.
Implement options to print the QR code directly from the patient dashboard. Ensure compatibility with common printer software and configurations.

Develop functionality to share the QR code directly from the platform via email or other digital means. Ensure this process adheres to data security protocols and allows for seamless integration with external applications.
Conduct thorough testing of the QR code generation and sharing features to ensure the data is correctly encapsulated and secure. Include unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing.
Document the QR code generation process, security measures, and usage instructions. Ensure that all documentation is clear and easily accessible to aid both technical support teams and users.
Plan and execute a feedback gathering session post-deployment to understand user satisfaction and areas for improvement in the QR code feature.

E007.Epic Description: Develop a system to generate a digital summary page of the patient's health information, which can be reviewed or shared digitally whenever needed.
E007.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to interact with an AI Chat Bot to get answers to my health-related queries so that I can have continuous support.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Chat bot is accessible from the patient dashboard.
Patients can type in queries and receive immediate responses.
Chat bot responses are based on the latest health data and guidelines.
Patients can save or bookmark useful Q&A for future reference.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement an AI Chat Bot interface accessible from the patient dashboard. This interface should be embedded within the existing patient dashboard layout, ensuring ease of access and user-friendliness.

Develop the backend functionality for the AI Chat Bot to receive typed queries from patients. The system should handle input in various formats and languages, using natural language processing to interpret and process the queries.

Integrate the AI Chat Bot with the hospital’s health data systems to ensure that the responses are based on the latest health data and medical guidelines. Ensure compliance with data privacy and security standards such as HIPAA.

Implement a feature within the AI Chat Bot interface that allows patients to receive immediate responses to their queries. Responses should be generated in real-time, leveraging pre-programmed responses and machine learning models.

Create functionality for patients to save or bookmark useful Q&A interactions with the AI Chat Bot. This should include options to save individual responses or entire conversations, with easy retrieval functionality from the patient dashboard.
Conduct thorough testing of the AI Chat Bot to ensure accuracy and reliability of responses, user interface usability, and robustness of the integration with health data systems.
Prepare and deploy training materials for hospital staff and informational guides for patients to educate them on how to interact with the AI Chat Bot effectively.
Set up a monitoring system to log interactions with the AI Chat Bot, analyze the usage patterns, and gather feedback from users to continually improve the system.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a feature allowing patients to generate a QR code that contains their medical history, enabling easy transfer to other healthcare providers.
E008.Story Title: Generate QR Code for Medical History
E008.Story Description: As a patient, I want to be able to generate a QR code that encapsulates my detailed medical history so that I can easily share it with any healthcare provider.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The QR code generation feature must be accessible through the patient's digital platform after login.
The QR code must encapsulate all current medical history data including conditions, medications, allergies, and past consultations.
The system must verify that the QR code correctly encodes the provided data.
The QR code must be readable by standard QR code scanning tools used by healthcare providers.

Tasks.Description: Implement a secure authentication mechanism that requires patients to log in before accessing the QR code generation feature. This should include standard security practices such as HTTPS and possibly two-factor authentication to ensure data protection.
Design and develop a user interface within the patient's digital platform where they can initiate the QR code generation process. Ensure this interface is intuitive and easily accessible post-login.

Create a backend service to fetch all relevant medical history data for the logged-in patient. This includes conditions, medications, allergies, and details of past consultations. Verify that the latest and complete data is pulled from the database.

Implement QR code generation logic that encodes the fetched medical history data into a QR code. Use a standard QR code library that supports encoding of large data sizes and consider encryption to secure the data within the QR code.

Develop a feature to verify the correctness of the encoded data in the QR code. This could involve decoding the QR code after generation and comparing the result with the original data to ensure accuracy.
Integrate the QR code generation feature with the ability to display the generated QR code on the user interface, allowing patients to view and verify their QR code immediately after generation.

Test the readability and compatibility of the generated QR code with standard QR code scanning tools commonly used by healthcare providers. This might involve testing with multiple devices and scanning applications.
Ensure that all data transmission during the QR code generation and verification process is encrypted and follows best security practices to protect patient information.

Document the development process and create a user manual that guides patients on how to generate and use the QR code. Include troubleshooting steps for common issues that may arise during the QR code generation or scanning process.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a feature allowing patients to generate a QR code that contains their medical history, enabling easy transfer to other healthcare providers.
E008.Story Title: Secure Data Transmission via QR Code
E008.Story Description: As a patient, I want to ensure that the data transmitted through my QR code is secure so that my medical information is protected against unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The QR code must use encryption to secure the medical data it contains.
Only authorized healthcare providers with the appropriate decryption key or app functionality can access the data from the QR code.
The system must log all accesses to the QR code data for audit and security monitoring purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop a secure encryption algorithm for encoding medical data into the QR code. Ensure the algorithm meets industry standards for data encryption.

Implement a decryption module that integrates with the healthcare provider's systems. This module should provide functionalities to decode the encrypted data from the QR code using a secure decryption key.

Create authentication protocols to verify that only authorized healthcare providers are able to access the decryption functionalities. Include multi-factor authentication as part of the access control.
Develop a logging system that captures all QR code data access attempts. The log should record details such as access time, user identity, and access result (successful or unsuccessful).
Conduct a security audit of the QR code data encryption and decryption processes to ensure they are secure and meet regulatory compliance requirements.
Create user documentation that guides healthcare providers on how to use the decryption key and app functionality to access patient data securely from the QR code.
Integrate the QR code generation and decryption functionalities into the existing patient data management system, ensuring seamless operation and data synchronization.
Perform thorough testing of the QR code encryption, decryption, and access logging functionalities under various scenarios to ensure reliability and security.
Deploy the updated system containing the new QR code features into a staging environment for live testing by a select group of healthcare providers.
Gather feedback from the healthcare providers during the pilot phase and make necessary adjustments to the encryption, decryption, and logging features based on their input.
Plan and conduct training sessions for healthcare providers to familiarize them with the new QR code features and best practices for secure data access.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a feature allowing patients to generate a QR code that contains their medical history, enabling easy transfer to other healthcare providers.
E008.Story Description: As a patient, I want to update my medical history on the platform so that the QR code generated reflects the most current and accurate health information.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients must be able to easily access and modify their medical history data through the user interface.
Changes in medical history must be instantly updated and reflected in any new QR code generated after the update.
The system must provide confirmation to the user that their data has been updated successfully.

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly interface for patients to access and edit their medical history, including sections for chronic conditions, medications, allergies, and surgical history.
Implement front-end functionality using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to allow patients to add, remove, or modify entries in their medical history on the platform.
Develop back-end API to handle requests for updating medical history in the database. This API should perform checks for data validation and authentication to ensure security.
Integrate the medical history update API with the front-end interface, ensuring seamless data flow and immediate updates on the user interface upon data modification.
Modify the existing QR code generation function to dynamically include the latest medical history data whenever a new QR code is requested by the patient.
Implement a confirmation mechanism on the user interface that notifies the patient when their medical history is successfully updated in the database and is reflected in the new QR code.
Conduct unit testing on the new features to ensure that the updates are handled correctly, data integrity is maintained, and the user receives the appropriate confirmation messages.
Perform integration testing to verify that changes in the medical history are accurately captured in the QR code generation without any data discrepancy.
Create user documentation that explains how to update medical history and generate QR codes with the updated information.
Deploy the updates to a staging environment for acceptance testing to ensure the feature meets user expectations and complies with the specified acceptance criteria.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a feature allowing patients to generate a QR code that contains their medical history, enabling easy transfer to other healthcare providers.
E008.Story Description: As a patient, I want to be able to review the medical history data that my QR code will contain before generating it so that I can verify its accuracy and completeness.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Before QR code generation, the patient must be presented with a summary of the medical data that will be encoded.
The patient must have the option to go back and make any necessary edits before the QR code is generated.
The system must ensure the data shown is exactly what will be encoded into the QR code.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function to retrieve patient medical history data from the database. Inputs include patient ID; outputs should be a structured summary of the patient's medical data.
Create a user interface component that displays the retrieved medical history data to the patient in a readable format, allowing them to review before QR code generation.

Implement a function that enables patients to edit their medical history data. Inputs should include fields like conditions, medications, and allergies, with corresponding outputs updating the database in real-time.
Design a 'Review and Confirm' page that summarizes all patient medical data to be encoded. This page should include buttons for confirming accuracy or returning to edit.
Develop a function to generate a QR code from the confirmed medical data. Inputs should be the patient's finalized medical history data; the output should be a QR code image.
Ensure data integrity by implementing checks that confirm the data to be encoded into the QR code matches the data displayed and confirmed by the patient.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a feature allowing patients to generate a QR code that contains their medical history, enabling easy transfer to other healthcare providers.
E008.Story Description: As a patient, I want to download the QR code to my device and have options to share it directly through email or other digital means so that I can easily provide it to healthcare providers.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must allow the QR code to be downloaded as an image file to the patient's device.
There should be options to share the QR code directly from the platform via email, text, or other digital platforms.
The downloaded or shared QR code must remain valid and not expire prematurely, ensuring it can be used at the next healthcare provider visit.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI component for QR code generation and display, ensuring it allows patients to view the generated QR code and provides an option to download it. Include a 'Download' button that patients can click to save the QR code as an image file on their device.

Implement backend functionality to generate a QR code based on the patient's medical history data. The QR code should encapsulate all relevant medical history details in an encrypted format to ensure data security.

Create a function that handles the conversion of the patient's medical history data into a QR code image. This function should ensure that the QR code is generated in a common image format (e.g., PNG, JPEG) suitable for download and sharing.

Develop the feature to allow the QR code to be shared directly via email, text, or other digital platforms from the patient's dashboard. This involves integrating with email services and other relevant APIs to facilitate direct sharing.

Ensure the downloaded or shared QR code maintains its validity and does not expire. Implement mechanisms to refresh the QR code data periodically or upon any updates to the patient's medical history to ensure it remains current.

Perform thorough testing of the QR code download and sharing functionalities to verify that they work as expected on different devices and platforms. Include tests for file format compatibility, data integrity in the QR code, and the persistence of the QR code's validity.

Document the workflow and instructions on how patients can download and share their QR codes. This documentation should be accessible via the patient's dashboard to help guide them through the process.

Implement security measures to ensure that the QR code generation, download, and sharing functionalities comply with healthcare data protection standards such as HIPAA. This includes encrypting the QR code data and securing the transmission channels.
